messages:
marta: Heads up — eu-west1c is spiking on GPU pod evictions, lots of tiny-gang churn and leftover single-slot fragments. ~95 eviction events in the last 60m :grimacing:
ben-scheduler: saw that. Correlates with rack-nic-health job toggling taints/cordon on a subset of racks -> latebind tiny pods get preempted and leave small holes that never coalesce
marta: quick paste from node events (truncated):
```
Node/eu-west1c-rack7-03  Warning   Evicting     Pod tiny-gang-abc   The node had condition: NetworkUnavailable
Node/eu-west1c-rack7-03  Normal    TaintAdded    Taint gpu_isolated=true:NoSchedule applied by rack-nic-health
Node/eu-west1c-rack7-04  Warning   Evicting     Pod tiny-gang-def   Preemption: resource shortage
```
infra-bot: autoscaler: scaled up eu-west1c by +4 nodes at 2024-02-xxT10:12Z (policy: gpu-demand)
oz-runtime: also seeing elevated inter-node retransmits and some NVLink complaints on those racks, might be intermittent NIC flaps causing the health job to be noisy. Warmpool refill isn't keeping up because many tiny pods are latebinded and scatter across nodes
ben-scheduler: plan: try debouncing the rack-nic-health taint toggle (30s) and temporarily increase warm-pool target for tiny-gang class to 8 in eu-west1c. Also enable small-pod coalescer to prefer packing tiny pods onto fewer nodes to reduce fragmentation
kai-sre: cost note — bumping warm-pool to 8 will increase reserved GPU hours. Can we do a narrower blast radius? maybe only apply to racks with >20 evicts in last 1h
marta: agree on narrower canary. Can someone run a 1h canary with debounce=30s only on eu-west1c-rack7-*. I'll watch eviction rate and tail latency in the console
ben-scheduler: pushing canary now: will update configmap/scheduler-tuning (eu-west1c) -> debounce=30s, warmpool-tiny=8, coalescer=on for 1h. If evictions drop -> extend.
rolloutbot: Started rollout 1705126780 -> configmap/scheduler-tuning (eu-west1c-rack7). Monitor: https://internal/rollouts/1705126780
marta: thanks. If this reduces the fragmentation, we can follow up with longer-term options: repair/replace flaky NICs on rack7, or tweak latebind heuristics to prefer nodes with recently freed tiny-slot capacity
ben-scheduler: will post results in ~1h. tagging @kai-sre for cost telemetry and @oz-runtime for NVLink traces
